Name: Fill the school
Author: gqhong
Description:
This mod is in testing phase and will have limited content and images.

Purpose :
The aim of this mod is to increase the number of NPCs and fill the school (mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54167332]xiddav[/url]) with more school going children and increase the rate in which Penny and Flor will work there.

[b]Caution[/b] : This mod adds little to no items, quests, story etc to the game, but it does give you a massive "traffic jam" during school going hours from the bus to the school area lol.

For the school mod please go here : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9695

1) [b]Changes to Penny and Flor Schedule. [/b]( Penny goes on weekdays and Flor goes adhoc )
This is to simulate a teacher and teaching assistant.
They will also take turns bringing the kids either to the Bus/Cable Car area or to Town and then to Marnie's farm
Penny also waits by the street lamp beside the clinic on weekday mornings to guide the kids to class. She also makes sure those hiding at the playground goes to their seats

2) [b]Penny and Flor will now share their "salary" with you.[/b]
Mayor Lewis will mail the payslip if you are married to either Penny or Flor at the end of each month
Fixed a duplicate issue

3) 12[b] kids[/b] will go from the bus and walk to school.
Seat 3 : Kara
Seat 11 : Muthu
Seat 14 : Ahmad
Seat 15 : Beng
Seat 1 Filler : Teela
Seat 2 Filler : Donny
Seat 8 Filler : Kitty 
Seat 9 Filler : Cammi ( by Nox )
Seat 10 Filler :  Amy 
Seat 13 Filler : Kimberly 
Seat 17 Filler : Peter 
Seat 18 Filler : Meha 

4) Added [b]schedule patch [/b]for SDV ( including Leo ), Ridgeside and East Scrap Kids

5) "Easter Eggs"
- [b]Kara's Secret[/b] : How does she get to East Scrap and get home on Sundays? She still appears on time for school the next day... Something is off...
- [b]Favourite characters [/b]: Can you identify what anime/cartoon characters are the kids' favourite?
- More secrets coming soon.

Planned Updates :
[s]- If Penny or Flor is married to player, to send a letter with her "salary"[/s]
- More activities in the school and playground
- Kids to visit Pelican on weekends with their parents
- Filling the rest of the seats with the option to disable if certain character mods are installed ( In progress )
- Heart events or Anti-Social NPC modes
- Non-Festival events / gatherings

Currently this has limited testing but seems to work with 1.5+, SVE, RSV and ES installed and those kids also goes to the school if the required mod is installed.

Refer to this link https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/832 for list of other mods that will add kids to the school.

If you would like to help in this project, please let me know :) This is my first upload so any help is greatly appreciated.

Special Thanks :
Nox for updated content to Cammi
